name: AddSOAPRequestHeader
description: Adds a SOAP header to a web service request before making the request.
syntax: AddSOAPRequestHeader( object webservice, string namespace, string name, object value, [boolean mustUnderstand] )

params.name: webservice
params.description: A web service object as returned from the cfobject tag or the CreateObject function.

params.name: namespace
params.description: A String that is the namespace for the header.

params.name: name
params.description: A String that is the name of the header

params.name: value
params.description: the value for the SOAP header; this can be a CFML XML value.

params.name: mustUnderstand
params.description: Sets the SOAP mustunderstand value for this header.
